svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 22 — FINAL SPLASH: Sable at the threshold
svg.desc: Full-page splash, no borders. Slightly low angle from behind/below Sable looking past her at vast gaslit Victorian London. Sable silhouetted at gutter lip — 4-inch figure against enormous cityscape. Behind: squad as 5 tiny colored lights in iron channel + dying wreckage. Before: vast amber cityscape — slate roofs, chimney forests, church spires, gas grid, Thames, fog layers. Above: faint last trace of falling star almost gone. Dual-lighting meets on Sable's figure. 2 caption boxes bottom.

g.text: They were soldiers from the end of time, stranded at the start of a story.
The city below would call them fairies.
